text: Set approval limits under Settings -> Team -> Approval limits. Choose a role or user, enter the per-transaction and daily caps, and Save. Interns and other roles can be given a lower cap on the same page.
Invite a teammate from Settings -> Team -> Members -> Invite. Enter their email, pick the Analytics module role, and send. They receive an email to join.
Change the forecast horizon under Settings -> Forecast -> Horizon. Pick 30, 60 or 90 days and Save; the next forecast run uses the new horizon.
Connect NetSuite under Settings -> Connections -> ERP. Choose NetSuite, paste the token bundle from NetSuite, and authorize the read scope.

keywords: export the cash report to excel
text: Export any report to Excel from the report view: click Export -> Excel (.xlsx). Large reports are emailed when ready.
Schedule a report from the report view -> Schedule. Pick weekly, choose the day and recipients, and Save.
Create a low-balance alert under Settings -> Alerts -> New. Select the account (e.g. EUR), set the threshold, and choose who is notified.
Change the base reporting currency under Settings -> Organization -> Reporting currency. This restates historical reports at the latest rates.

keywords: map new accounts into the cash categories
text: Map accounts to cash categories under Settings -> Categories. Drag each new account into a category, or set a rule to auto-map by name.
Re-categorize a transaction from the transaction list: open it, click Category, and pick the correct bucket. The change is logged.
Forecast confidence bands show the range within which actuals are expected to fall: the inner band is ~50% likelihood, the outer band ~90%, based on historical forecast error.
